thread:
alex: Heads up — cutoff for v2.8.0 in ~90m. Please avoid new merges unless it's an exception. I'm raising a possible late-merge for a hotfix: issue #4567 (kv-cache crash observed on Dedicated customers).
maria: Can you paste the reproduce steps and a quick risk summary?
alex: Repro steps in staging: run long convo with >8k tokens, background batch eviction triggers NPE in kv cache. Crash rate ~1/5000 reqs. Risk: runtime-only, small kernel change. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4822
sanjay: Thanks. Is CI green? Any flaky tests or infra changes? We need a rollback plan before approving.
jen: If it's touching cache management, we should canary first. Also need changelog line and a one-liner for release notes.
alex: CI: all green on main + integration smoke passed on staging. No infra or schema changes. PR includes unit tests + a repro test that was failing before. Rollback plan: revert the merge commit or cherry-pick a revert to release branch. Commands below.
alex: ```
# to revert on release branch
git checkout release/v2.8
git revert <merge-commit-sha> -m 1
# fast rollback via cherry-pick if needed
git checkout release/v2.8
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha-before-hotfix>
```
lee: Oncall here — I can monitor canary. Recommend canary rollout 5% for 20m, then 25% for 30m if no regressions, then full. Watch latency and error spikes on kv operations.
deploy-bot: deploy/canary job started for runtime-pr-4822 — build 2026.03.17-13:12 — smoke: passed ✅
sanjay: OK. Accepting exception contingent on: 1) changelog entry 2) canary smoke for 20m 3) tagging PR with "release-exception" and link in release tracker.
alex: Will add changelog and tag now. Also adding a brief monitoring dashboard link once canary is live.
maria: Small ask — bump patch version to 2.8.1 in the release manifest if we merge after cutoff? Or do we keep 2.8.0 and note it as hotpatch?
sanjay: We'll keep the branch release/v2.8 as-is but annotate release notes with hotpatch 2.8.1 (post-merge). Ops will cut a patch after merge. Document the exact commit for traceability.
jen: Please also run a quick perf comparison vs previous runtime (latency P50/P95) and paste numbers here. If we see regressions >5% we bail.
ale: (typo) alex: will paste perf numbers in 10m.
lee: I'm watching logs — no new errors so far at 5% canary.
deploy-bot: promote/canary -> 25% scheduled in 18m if no alerts.
alex: changelog added in PR + "release-exception" label applied. PR description updated with rollback commands and monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.company/r/d/kv-cache-hotpatch
maria: Thanks. Quick ping to release docs: note exception and that post-merge we must cut 2.8.1 and update package manifest.
sanjay: Marking this thread as decision: exception approved with canary gating. If anything goes sideways, revert immediately and notify #eng-oncall.
lee: Acknowledged. I'll post incident if we see >0.5% error spike.
jen: Thx all. Alex — ping here when full rollout completes.
alex: Will do. Current plan: merge in 60m if canary remains healthy, then follow rollout.
deploy-bot: deploy/full rollout started — build 2026.03.17-13:58 — rollout 100% — smoke checks running.
lee: Monitoring: P50 +2%, P95 +1% — within tolerance. No error rise.
alex: Merged and deployed. Changelog + release notes updated. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
